quote.text: Neither can beauty or strength make you blessed, for none of these qualities can withstand old age. What we have to seek for, then, is that which does not each day pass more and more under the control of some power which cannot be withstood. And what is this? It is the soul, – but the soul that is upright, good, and great. What else could you call such a soul than a god dwelling as a guest in a human body? A soul like this may descend into a Roman knight just as well as into a freedman's son or a slave. For what is a Roman knight, or a freedmen's son, or a slave? They are mere titles, born of ambition or of wrong. One may leap to heaven from the very slums. Only rise And mould thyself to kinship with thy God. This moulding will not be done in gold or silver; an image that is to be in the likeness of God cannot be fashioned of such materials; remember that the gods, when they were kind unto men, were moulded in clay. Farewell.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as Seneca teaches that beauty and strength fade with time, a parent can find solace in nurturing a resilient and virtuous soul in their child—one that endures challenges and grows with life's lessons.
    • Focus on instilling integrity and moral character rather than superficial achievements; by molding inner strength and virtue, you empower your child to rise above external labels and transient circumstances.
  • Leadership
    • In leadership, the true measure of influence lies not in fleeting power or physical prowess, but in the strength of character; a leader's soul relentlessly seeks what is upright, good, and enduring.
    • When you lead by example, cultivating a virtuous spirit and ethical behavior, you inspire those around you to consider their own inner strength and commit to a purpose greater than personal ambition.
  • Product Management
    • Much like refining one's inner virtues, creating a timeless product requires more than superficial appeal or temporary trends—it demands a focus on quality, reliability, and the enduring needs of your users.
    • By anchoring your decisions in principled values and a deep understanding of your users' true requirements, you build products that stand resilient against the inevitable changes and challenges of the market.
